Participants in a MOOC discussion forum

Source: R/data.R
mooc_people.Rd

The participant table accompanying mooc_posts: every person who appears as a sender or a receiver there, with the self-reported experience level the chapter recodes into Expert, Student and Teacher and then uses as the mixing attribute.

Usage

mooc_people

Format

A data frame with 445 rows and 2 columns:

name

Character. Participant identifier, matching the sender and receiver columns of mooc_posts.

experience

Integer. Self-reported experience level: 1 expert, 2 student, 3 teacher.

Source

As mooc_posts.

See also

mooc_posts; vignette("ch17-temporal-networks").

Examples

participants <- dynet(mooc_posts, from = "sender", to = "receiver",
                      time = "timestamp", thread = "discussion",
                      nodes = mooc_people)
#> Dropped 86 self-loop event(s). Use loops = TRUE to keep them.
as.data.frame(participants, what = "nodes")
